sloka: वालुकावेदिमध्ये तु तल्लिङ्गं स्थाप्य रावणः ।अर्चयामास गन्धैश्च पुष्पैश्चामृतगन्धिभिः ।। ७.३१.४२ ॥
transliteration: vālukāvedimadhye tu talliṅgaṁ sthāpya rāvaṇaḥ ।arcayāmāsa gandhaiśca puṣpaiścāmṛtagandhibhiḥ ।। 7.31.42 ॥

translations.english: Ravana placed that Lingam in the middle of a sand altar and worshipped it with fragrant substances and flowers that smelled like nectar.
